# featureflip_organization (Data Source)

Look up an organization. Defaults to the provider's organization when slug is omitted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "featureflip_organization" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `plan` (String)
